findings.text: step_gpu_indices reads only SLURM_STEP_GPUS, which the serve's launch path never sets: the generated script is submitted with sbatch (imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:1109) and launches the engine inline in the batch step (slurm.py:829) with no srun anywhere in the generator (zero occurrences), and SLURM excludes batch steps from SLURM_STEP_GPUS -- the variable the deployment does carry is SLURM_JOB_GPUS, which this repository's own gpu-preemptible-scheduling record captured as "SLURM_JOB_GPUS=2,3,6,7" against a CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES remapped to 0..3. Every row the recorder writes therefore carries index_source "nvidia-smi" with read-order indices, so a step whose cards are not 0..N-1 labels them with another job's numbers and the section reads as a valid measurement rather than as an unmapped one; the section already records step_gpus beside the numbering, so the fix is to accept SLURM_JOB_GPUS as well and let the all-or-nothing length rule do the rest.

read_cards accepts a timeout_s and never passes it to run -- the RunFn protocol takes the argument vector alone and the only consumer of a timeout is run_capture's own parameter -- so the knob is inert, demonstrated here by read_cards(timeout_s=0.05) against a two-second nvidia-smi, which waited 2.07 s and returned a one-card section instead of the absence a configured timeout would give; read_cpu_times, read_meminfo and read_jobs carry the same dead parameter, and read_jobs documents 15 s for a SLURM RPC against an effective cap of run_capture's default 10 s, so NodeProbe(timeout_s=...) configures nothing.

justifications.durability: An assertion fails if the change regresses -- the mapping test is red under the declared mutation, reproduced here at 1 failed, 2 passed, 24 deselected -- and the per-source absence rule has a test per source rather than one aggregate; docked because nothing in the suite fails if the deployment's index source goes missing (the tests can only assert on the env mapping they are handed) and nothing fails if NodeProbe.timeout_s stays inert.
justifications.evidence: Every clause of the dispatched done-when was reproduced independently here from a second worktree -- 27 passed in tests/test_node_probe.py, per-source absence asserted for cards, host and jobs, the mapping asserted on a fixture where read order and allocation differ, and ruff check imas_ambix tests exit 0 -- and the negative control was re-derived rather than read: the declared mutation to node_probe.py:231 fails exactly test_card_indices_come_from_the_step_allocation_not_the_read_order with [0, 1] == [6, 7] and nothing else; docked because the mapping clause is asserted only against an environment the fixture hands the parser, so the gate passes while the variable it depends on does not exist on the serve (finding 1), and because a configured quantity that has no effect (finding 2) is the same class of silent absence this section exists to remove.
justifications.fit: The module follows the repository's idiom for a sparse-section producer -- module docstring stating the absence-by-omission rule, named module constants for the query fields, from __future__ import annotations, no raising for a failed probe -- both new files are already formatted under the repository's own py314 formatter, the serving-interpreter parse guard passes for the whole package, and no plan, ticket or version identifier appears in a symbol, filename or comment; docked because two of the three per-tick reads fork a cat for a file the process can open itself, against a done-when whose cost clause is unmeasured, and because the exception-tuple workaround at node_probe.py:84 solves by naming what the repository's designated mechanism -- a per-file-target-version pin -- solves for every other serving-imported module.
justifications.goal_fidelity: All three readings section 3 names are returned from one module -- per-card utilisation, temperature, power draw, power cap, both clocks and memory from a single nvidia-smi query (imas_ambix/agent/node_probe.py:48), CPU busy fraction with the jiffies behind it and memory in MiB from /proc (node_probe.py:346), and squeue -h -w <hostname> (node_probe.py:458) -- docked because the file's own stated purpose of labelling a card "by the number the node knows it by" (node_probe.py:22) is not reached by the deployment's launch path (see finding 1).
justifications.scope_discipline: The two commits touch exactly the five declared write paths and nothing else (515 lines of node_probe.py, 365 of tests/test_node_probe.py, the figure, the plan comment and the evidence anchor), serving_receipts.py is left untouched exactly as the build/wire split in section 7 requires, and the plan-version and plan-modified meta lines are unedited (the plan diff is the three-line comment insertion alone).
